title: Jailer 2 streams on Prime Video from 12 Nov in five languages; Jailer (2023) already on Prime
headline: Jailer 2 Streams on Prime Video From Thursday, 12 Nov
caption:
Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 streams on Prime Video from Thursday, 12 November, with audio in Tamil, Telugu, Hindi, Malayalam and Kannada. It will stream in India and in more than 240 countries and territories.

The first Jailer has been on Prime Video since September 2023, so both films will be on the same service. Nelson Dilipkumar directed the sequel, which Sun Pictures produced.

Jailer 2 opened in cinemas on 15 October. Trade tracker Sacnilk puts its worldwide gross at over ₹820 crore, which it says makes Jailer 2 the highest-grossing Tamil film yet.

Did you catch Jailer 2 in a theatre, or are you waiting for the stream?

Sources: The Hollywood Reporter India, Outlook India, DT Next, Gulf News, Sacnilk, The Tribune
